$comment: MCP tool catalogue for codetopo, extracted from the live server binary, not hand-written. The `tools` array below is the verbatim `result.tools` payload of a JSON-RPC `tools/list` call against `codetopo-mcp` over stdio. Regenerate with: printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}' | cargo run -q -p codetopo-mcp

tools.description: Index a repository into a codetopo graph database.

db_path.description: Path of the database to create.

package.description: Package name. Defaults to the repository directory name.

repo_path.description: Path to the repository to index.

tools.name: codetopo_index
tools.title: Index a repository

tools.description: Nodes transitively reachable from a node over calls and imports edges.

expand.description: Return full node objects instead of ids. Default false.

node.description: Node id to walk down from.

tools.name: codetopo_descendants
tools.title: Find descendants

tools.description: Nodes from which a node is transitively reachable over calls and imports edges.

expand.description: Return full node objects instead of ids. Default false.

node.description: Node id to walk up from.

tools.name: codetopo_ancestors
tools.title: Find ancestors

tools.description: Nodes that break if a node changes: dependents, overriders, and implementers.

expand.description: Return full node objects instead of ids. Default false.

node.description: Node id whose blast radius to compute.

tools.name: codetopo_blast_radius
tools.title: Compute blast radius

tools.description: Shortest typed path between two nodes, or the reason there is none.
tools.name: codetopo_path
tools.title: Find the path between two nodes

tools.description: Node and edge totals for an index, with per-kind breakdowns.
tools.name: codetopo_stats
tools.title: Index statistics

tools.description: Verify the tamper-evident audit chain of an index.
tools.name: codetopo_verify
tools.title: Verify the index audit chain

tools.description: Export the whole graph as a portable snapshot, bound to the audit head.
tools.name: codetopo_snapshot
tools.title: Export a graph snapshot

tools.description: The diagnostics recorded when the index was built - dependency cycles, multi-definitions, unresolved calls, and the rest - as data, exactly as the CLI prints them.
tools.name: codetopo_diagnostics
tools.title: Read the index diagnostics

tools.description: The top symbols by fan-in, fan-out, blast-radius size, or cyclomatic complexity - counts over the graph, with the count's method stated in the result. A ranking of measurements, never a score of code quality.

by.description: Metric to rank by: fan_in, fan_out, blast_radius (default), or complexity.

tools.name: codetopo_rank
tools.title: Rank symbols by a measured count

tools.description: Compare two indexes (or two snapshot files): added, removed, and changed nodes and edges, plus the blast-radius movement of every touched symbol. Give exactly one before source and one after source.

after_db_path.description: Path to the after index database.

after_snapshot.description: Path to the after snapshot file (alternative to after_db_path).

before_db_path.description: Path to the before index database.

before_snapshot.description: Path to the before snapshot file (alternative to before_db_path).

tools.name: codetopo_diff
tools.title: Diff two indexes (change impact)

tools.description: Coupling and cohesion measurements for every type and package (CODE_SCHEMA section 9): CBO, RFC, LCOM pair counts, TCC, ATFD, WMC per type; Ca, Ce, instability, and separately-named external coupling per package. Every metric's method is stated in the result. Measurements only - no thresholds, no verdicts.
tools.name: codetopo_metrics
tools.title: Coupling and cohesion metrics

tools.description: Hotspots (change frequency x complexity, both factors stated) and change coupling (support/confidence as pair counts) over a local working tree's git history. History is local-only: without repo_path the answer is the unmeasured report (measured: false with the reason), never invented numbers.

min_support.description: Minimum support for a coupled pair to be reported. Default 2.

repo_path.description: Local working tree whose git history is read. Omit for the unmeasured report.

since.description: Only commits since this date (passed to git log --since).

tools.name: codetopo_history
tools.title: Change-history measurements (hotspots, change coupling)

tools.description: The subgraph within a few hops of a node, in both directions (contains/defines excluded).
tools.name: codetopo_neighborhood
tools.title: Get a node's neighborhood

tools.description: One node in full - kind, location, tier, defines and refs - plus its incident edges grouped by kind and direction, with counts (containment excluded). Errors when the id is unknown.
tools.name: codetopo_get_symbol
tools.title: Get one symbol in full

tools.description: Find symbols by name (case-insensitive substring of the label) - the discovery step before the exact-id queries.
tools.name: codetopo_search_symbols
tools.title: Search symbols by name

tools.description: The schema this server speaks: node and edge kinds, tier rules, and the query vocabulary. Needs no database.
tools.name: codetopo_describe_schema
tools.title: Describe the schema
